description.zh: 把 AI 生成或 AI 味重的中文（兼顾英文）文稿改得自然、准确、像本人写的：按有语料实测依据的规则清理翻案腔、总结腔、翻译腔、拔高词、顿号罗列、序数小标题和聊天残留，只改该改的地方，不新增事实、不改原意；逐行标出 AI 痕迹，改完核对数字、引语、专名、否定和限定是否被改动；可按作者旧稿校准风格，或从一开始写出没有 AI 味的稿子。
description.en: Makes AI-generated or AI-sounding Chinese (and English) writing read naturally and accurately, like the author wrote it: applies corpus-backed rules to remove contrast frames, summary filler, translationese, inflated words, list stacking, ordinal headings and chatbot residue with minimal edits and no new facts; flags AI tells line by line, verifies rewrites keep numbers, quotes, names, negations and hedges, calibrates to the author's voice, or writes AI-free drafts from scratch.

welcome_message.zh: 把要去 AI 味的稿子发给我，说说是你自己写的还是 AI 初稿
welcome_message.en: Send me the draft and tell me whether you wrote it or it's an AI draft

prompt.zh: 帮我把这篇稿子去 AI 味，意思和数据都别改：___
prompt.en: Remove the AI tone from this draft without changing meaning or data: ___

prompt.zh: 帮我检查这篇稿子哪里 AI 味重，逐行标出来并说明改法：___
prompt.en: Check where this draft sounds AI-written and explain fixes line by line: ___

prompt.zh: 这是我以前写的文章 ___，按我的风格帮我改这篇：___
prompt.en: Here are my past articles ___; rewrite this one in my voice: ___

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇 ___（公众号 / 汇报 / 文案），写得自然，不要有 AI 味。
prompt.en: Write a ___ (article / report / copy) that reads naturally, with no AI tone.

prompt.zh: 对比原稿和改稿，看看有没有改错意思、丢了数据：原稿 ___ 改稿 ___
prompt.en: Compare the original and edited drafts for changed meaning or lost data: ___ / ___

prompt.zh: 把这段英文改得不那么像 AI 写的，事实都保留：___
prompt.en: Make this English text sound less AI-generated, keep all facts: ___

zh: 每次写完公众号初稿后「立即」检查 AI 味并给出改稿
每周五「17:00」把本周的工作汇报去 AI 味并核对数据
每月 1 日「10:00」根据我最新的几篇文章更新风格卡
每天「18:00」检查当天发出的文案有没有聊天残留和惊叹号
每周一「9:00」汇总上周改稿中最常见的 AI 痕迹
收到新的产品介绍初稿后「立即」去掉拔高词和拟人化比喻
en: After each article draft, check AI tone and return an edited version
Every Friday at 17:00, humanize this week's work report and verify the data
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, refresh my style card from recent articles
Every day at 18:00, check today's copy for chatbot residue and exclamation marks
Every Monday at 9:00, summarise last week's most common AI tells
When a new product description draft arrives, remove inflated words and personified metaphors
